expected_level_description: You can: - own the organisation's annual report and accounts and the accounting policies behind them - advise the board and audit committee on significant judgements and new standards - lead the response to qualified audit opinions or material misstatements - assure that reporting meets public accountability rules
You can: - set the organisation's treasury policy and banking arrangements - advise the board on liquidity and cash risks - manage cash within the limits set by funders and public sector rules

You can: - own the organisation's financial rules and scheme of delegation - report to the audit committee on financial control and audit actions - lead the response to significant control failures or fraud - build a culture where staff understand their duty to use public money properly

You can: - manage the organisation's tax returns and tax reconciliations - advise on the tax treatment of contracts, such as software licences, cloud services, and shared services - maximise tax recovery within the rules

You can: - represent the organisation with funders and oversight bodies - advise the board on regularity, propriety, and value for money - shape funding agreements and financial regimes for the organisation's services
You can: - influence or create complex budgets across an organisation, programme or product view - manage the budget you are given and make it work

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - run the governance cycle for boards and committees - review policies and advise on compliance
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
